correctness.rationale: The proof derives the Zorn multiplication identities and treats all four norm/trace cases. For pure nilpotent first factors it proves rank L_x=4 using polarized alternativity and the nilpotent square relation, then proves trace nonzero on the left kernel, yielding the 3-dimensional mutual kernel. The nonzero-trace case is exactly the span of the conjugate. The two explicit irreducible cones and constant-rank bundles establish component dimensions; scissor relations yield the motivic identity. Direct rank calculations over every element of F2, F3 and F4 confirm the field cases. No inference of an infinite theorem from the finite tests is used.

originality.rationale: The assessed new claim is the characteristic-free global four-component classification together with a motivic point-count identity and resulting finite-field zeta function. value.rationale: Mutual annihilation in noncommutative alternative algebras is a natural two-sided zero-divisor invariant. Unlike an isolated rank fact, the result separates four irreducible global geometric pieces and computes the universal class in K0(Var_k), implying all finite extension counts and an explicit zeta function uniformly in characteristic two and odd characteristics. This quantitative arithmetic geometry is motivated by and goes beyond the known G2 pure-null incidence relation.
